content.title: How to buy Pittsburgh Penguins vs. Philadelphia Flyers NHL playoff tickets
content.text: April 14, 2026Updated April 15, 2026, 10:46 a.m. ETThe Pittsburgh Penguins and Philadelphia Flyers go head-to-head in the first round of the NHL Playoffs.The Penguins host a maximum of four games while the Flyers host a maximum of three games depending on how long the series lasts.Ticket prices start at $160.Playoff hockey is right around the corner as the NHL Eastern Conference features a classic in-state rivalry matchup to kick off the first round.The long-standing rivalry between the Pittsburgh Penguins and Philadelphia Flyers will be renewed as they'll face off in the postseason for the first time since 2018.SHOP: Penguins vs. Flyers 2026 NHL playoff ticketsWhat many thought would be a down year for the Penguins has turned into playoff hopes as stars Sidney Crosby and Evgeni Malkin have turned back the clock and put the Pens on the verge of a 100 point regular season.Philadelphia enjoyed a rebound season after missing the playoffs last year as they were led by the duo of Travis Konecny and Trevor Zegras, who clinched the final playoff spot in the Eastern Conference for the Flyers with a shootout win over Carolina on Monday night.With every playoff game in the series set to be held in Pennsylvania, there's simply no excuse for attending this rivalry series at least once or twice.
